verdict.rationale: Databricks documents plugging MCP servers into its agent stack. Agents can use built-in system.ai MCP Services and external MCP servers you register, giving governed access to tools like Slack, GitHub and Google Drive. Agent code can discover, authenticate to and call managed, MCP Service and custom MCP servers, and MCP servers are listed in Marketplace and governed as Unity Catalog objects. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and evidence that the built-in Genie Code assistant itself (not just custom agent code) can consume registered MCP servers.
